info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Interactive Help API
info.description: The Interactive Help API facilitates seamless assistance across banking platforms by enabling users to access tailored support and guidance. This API allows businesses to enhance customer satisfaction by integrating dynamic help resources directly into their applications, ensuring users receive relevant information in real-time. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and their online platforms, which can implement interactive help features to improve user experience. By leveraging this service, clients can address user inquiries efficiently and reduce support costs.

post.summary: Create interactive help content for cross-channel support.
post.description: This operation allows you to generate and submit interactive help resources that enhance user experience across multiple channels. It is designed to streamline the support process by providing tailored assistance seamlessly.
